expected_outcomes: Performance claims are reproducible measurements rather than isolated numbers.
required_actions: Define workload and environment, record baseline and changed measurements, report variance and limitations, and optimize demonstrated bottlenecks.
expected_documents: Benchmark methodology, baseline, comparison, and limitations.
acceptance: Correctness and maintainability remain protected and published measurements include methodology.
verification: Run the pinned benchmark repeatedly and compare against its baseline.
evidence: Raw timings, environment metadata, comparison report, and variance.
failure_conditions: A performance claim lacks measurement, baseline, environment, or methodology.
exceptions: Record why a representative workload cannot be executed and mark the result NOT_VERIFIED.
